description: Initialization only: Evaluate the ascending-ID order, then enumerate the other task permutations in depth-first order. Return the best issued trial after all permutations or the evaluation limit. If enumeration completes, every order has been tried once; the result is the best returned trial, not an exact solution of the full scheduling problem. Reassignment is not implemented.
Purpose: Inspect distinct orders systematically; completeness depends on finishing within the evaluation limit.
